tasks.title: Announcement #49
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
tasks.transcript: M: I'm pleased to announce that we'll have a guest speaker next week as part of our unit on environmental policy. Doctor Maya Ken will join us on Thursday and she'll be speaking about international climate agreements, the role of youth activism, and current challenges in global sustainability efforts. There will be time for questions at the end, so feel free to prepare some in advance. This talk should give you valuable insights for your upcoming group project. So please make sure to be there.

questions.stem: What field does the guest speaker most likely work in?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：客座演讲者最有可能从事哪个领域？ 定位原文：Doctor Maya Ken will join us on Thursday and she'll be speaking about international climate agreements, the role of youth activism, and current challenges in global sustainability efforts. 选项分析： A. 气候政策。演讲者谈论的内容包括国际气候协议和全球可持续发展挑战，这些都是气候政策领域的核心议题，因此A选项正确。 B. 海洋生物学。演讲内容完全没有提及海洋生物或相关话题，因此B选项错误。 C. 城市研究。演讲内容聚焦于全球气候和可持续发展，并未涉及城市规划或城市问题，因此C选项错误。 D. 公共卫生。演讲内容与公共健康、疾病预防等话题无关，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply about the guest lecturer's talk?

options.A: It will be useful for an upcoming project.
options.B: It will replace a required assignment.
options.C: It will be recorded and posted online.
options.D: It has been given in other classes.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：关于客座讲师的演讲，说话者暗示了什么？ 定位原文：This talk should give you valuable insights for your upcoming group project. 选项分析： A. 它将对接下来的一个项目有用。原文明确表示这次演讲会为学生们即将开始的小组项目提供宝贵的见解，因此A选项正确。 B. 它将替代一项必修作业。原文只提到演讲对项目有帮助，并未说它会替代任何作业或任务，因此B选项错误。 C. 它会被录下来并发布到网上。原文完全没有提及录音或网络发布的相关信息，因此C选项错误。 D. 它已经在其他班级讲过。说话者只是宣布了这次演讲的安排，并未提及它是否在其他班级重复过，因此D选项错误。
